newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ALARDO CHARGE KNOCKS SPADEL IN THE RED.
newsitem.headline: ALARDO CHARGE KNOCKS SPADEL IN THE RED.

text.p: Full year 1996
(in million Belgian francs unless stated)
Group net (ex. minorities) loss -65 vs 128 profit
Exceptional costs 169 vs nil
Note - Belgian beverage firm Spadel said the exceptional
loss was related to the temporary halt of the activities of its
Portuguese mineral water bottling unit Alardo. Spadel had warned
about the 169 million charge on March 28.
Cons turnover 8,345 vs 8,920
Pretax cashflow 1,142 vs 1,246
Pretax operating profit 255 vs 255
Taxes 150 vs 126
Net dividend (in francs) 366 vs 366
NOTE - Spadel said the number of liters sold fell by 7.6
percent, mainly due to the fact that the hot summer of 1995 was
not repeated in 1996. However, it benefitted from the price fall
of PET plastics.
In March Portuguese authorities ordered production and sale
of Alardo water be halted after it was found to contain
plankton. Alardo water was withdrawn from retailers' shelves.
Production was halted for a total 10 days.
